newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Mundial Confianca hits high for 96.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Mundial Confianca hits high for 96.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese insurer Mundial Confianca hit a high for this year of 1,369 escudos amid expectations of good results and encouraged by the strength of foreign markets after Bill Clinton's re-election, dealers said.
"The rise of Mundial Confianca is due to the strength of foreign markets following Clinton's re-election," said a dealer.
"Rumours that the nine-month results of Mundial Confianca and its bank Banco Totta e Acores will be good, are also driving up the stock," another dealer said.
Mundial Confianca stood at 1,369 escudos, up 48, in volume of 52,300 shares at 1032 GMT.
